entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Please, can you just wait and—

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: What's past here?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: That's...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: So the door Mona mentioned[n]is up ahead...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I keep telling you, you can't...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: You're still not done!?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: It's hard to do this... with cat paws!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Is something the matter?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Oh, ummm... Sooo, what is this room?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: It's a storage area for old paintings.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Storage...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Hey, Kitagawa-kun... Why don't we...[n]do it in here?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I won't be embarrassed if we go[n]somewhere nobody can find us...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Only Sensei can go in there.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Pleeease...? I wanna be alone with you.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Somewhere like, quiet. You know,[n]where we won't get interrupted.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: ...Is he really going to buy that[n]terrible act!?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Stay focused!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Hm?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Ohhh, it's just sooo frustrating that[n]my feelings aren't getting through[n]to you!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Kitagawa-kun, do you not like girls[n]like me?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: N-No, that's not true...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: How is that working on him!?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Please? We can continue this... inside...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: S-Sure...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I mean, no! We can't go in there!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: It's locked anyway, so...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Fine! This is too embarrassing...[n]I'm leaving!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: But...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Let's just do it in here! Okay!?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: What do I do?

entries.speaker: Madarame
entries.en: I'm home.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: S-Sensei!?

entries.speaker: Madarame
entries.en: Yusuke?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: All right, it's open!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Huh?

entries.speaker: Madarame
entries.en: What are you doing there!?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I-It's... It's not what it looks like!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Wha—!?

entries.speaker: Madarame
entries.en: Not in there!
